headline: Nigeria's Linkage Assurance 9M Profit Increases 31% to N4.09 Billion
summary: Nigerian underwriting firm Linkage Assurance reported a 31% increase in nine-month profit after tax to N4.09 billion. Total assets grew to over N100 billion.
why: Linkage Assurance is a major non-life insurance company in Nigeria providing risk management solutions.

impacts.name: Linkage Assurance Plc
impacts.why: The insurance firm posted strong 31% nine-month profit growth.
